rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords in Santa Ana can only raise rent once a year, and the increase cannot exceed the lower of 3% or 80% of the change in CPI; if CPI is negative, no increase is allowed.
rules.key_value: lower of 3% per year or 80% of CPI change
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental properties in Santa Ana; excludes buildings constructed after February 1, 1995 and mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995; mobile home spaces offered for rent after January 1, 1990.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Mun. Code, Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period. If the CPI is negative, no rent increase is permitted.
